Despite being a member of Congress, I still continue, as I have for over 30 years, to take care of patients with prostate cancer. Medical treatment for this disease has come along way during my career. My prayers are with him and his family.

Here are my thoughts on President Biden’s diagnosis: https://t.co/Z0f9AZYSuL
